mapper.select: select count(*) from fun_physics_puzzle_record where user_id = #{userId} and is_completed = 1

select difficulty, count(*) as total_count, sum(case when is_completed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, avg(time_spent) as avg_time from fun_physics_puzzle_record where user_id = #{userId} group by difficulty
